subject: Portal field canonization + lightweight migration plan
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@clearbridgesecurity.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: OneTrust Onboarding <onetrust-onboard@clearbridgesecurity.com>
Date: 2026-11-21 09:12 PST
Subject: Field export from OneTrust + a couple mapping questions

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As promised I'm attaching a CSV export of the fields we currently maintain in our OneTrust profile (clearbridge_onetrust_field_list.csv). A couple quick things we noticed and want to confirm before we start the staged import into Vendr:  

- We have two fields that look like duplicates: "ServiceScope" and "Service_Scope" (different capitalization/underscore). Which should map to Redwood's canonical claim?
- We include a free-text "EvidenceLocation" that sometimes contains S3 paths and sometimes Doc links; is there a preferred target field to normalize that into?
- We maintain a "PrimaryContact:Title" field; your onboarding docs recommended splitting contact metadata into separate rows rather than compound fields. Do you have a sample format we should follow?

If you can share the canonical mapping template you use on your side we can prepare a clean export for ingestion. We're aiming for a small dry-run (25 profiles) next Tuesday (11/24) to validate ingest logic and drop any edge-case rows.

Attachments: clearbridge_onetrust_field_list.csv

Happy to hop on a quick call if that's simpler.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Trust & Security
ClearBridge Security

---

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@clearbridgesecurity.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: Field export from OneTrust + a couple mapping questions

Alex — thanks for the export and the clear questions. Quick answers below, plus I'll attach a canonical map template and a tiny ingest preview script to help with the dry-run.

- ServiceScope vs Service_Scope: map both to canonical field "service_scope" (lowercase, underscore). We'll treat the variation as an alias during ingest.
- EvidenceLocation: normalize into two fields: "evidence_storage_type" (values: s3, doclink, other) and "evidence_location" (the raw path/URL). The ingest script will try to auto-detect s3:// prefixes and set storage_type accordingly; everything else will default to doclink.
- PrimaryContact:Title: please split into separate contact rows with columns contact_name, contact_email, contact_title. Vendr expects repeated-contact rows rather than compound fields.

I'm attaching: redwood_canonical_map_v1.csv (our mapping template) and ingest_preview_script.py (small script that previews row transforms). Please use the mapping template to produce the dry-run CSV.

Planner note: We're fine with a 11/24 dry-run window but would like to reserve the 09:00–12:00 PST slot for the first ingestion attempt and monitoring. Can your team commit to that?

Thanks — looping in Ben and Marissa for any policy or portal-side gotchas.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Principal, Trust Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_canonical_map_v1.csv; ingest_preview_script.py

---

From: Alex Turner <alex@clearbridgesecurity.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21 11:28 PST
Subject: Re: Field export from OneTrust + a couple mapping questions

Logan —

Perfect, that clarifies a lot. We can commit to the 09:00–12:00 PST window on 11/24 for the dry-run. I'll prepare a 25-row sample using your redwood_canonical_map_v1.csv and send it by EOD Monday (11/23). Couple of follow-ups:  

- Will the ingest script perform any validation on CAIQ/SIG-specific claim sets (e.g., detecting missing SOC2 control references)? If not, we'll run our own pre-checker and flag obvious mismatches before the push.
- If the dry-run ingest fails for a row, what's your rollback behavior? Do you reject at the row level or abort the whole batch?

We'll include a contact from our SRE team on the dry-run email thread in case we need to triage network or permission issues during the S3 pull.

Thanks — attaching a short preview CSV in the next message.

Best,
Alex

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@clearbridgesecurity.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23 16:43 PST
Subject: Re: Field export from OneTrust + a couple mapping questions

Alex / Logan —

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Quick policy points before the dry-run:  

- Validation: the ingest_preview_script.py performs syntactic checks (required fields present, S3 prefix detection, email format for contacts). It does not assert semantic CAIQ/SIG coverage. For that we recommend running your CAIQ pre-checker and tagging any control_id fields with "cb_precheck:FAIL" in the sample so we can skip/annotate them during import.
- Failure mode: our pipeline is row-transactional for the dry-run. A failed row will be rejected and logged; the rest of the batch will proceed. We'll produce a reconciliation CSV with error codes (see sample in the script). For full production imports we default to fail-fast unless we agree otherwise in the run plan.
- Backups & evidence: before we run the ingestion we will snapshot the existing Vendr profiles and store the snapshot in a timeboxed S3 path (link will be provided). This allows a fast rollback if there are unexpected mappings.

Action items:  
1) Alex: send the 25-row sample in redwood_canonical_map_v1 format by 11/23 EOD.
2) ClearBridge SRE: share a short-lived IAM role or pre-signed S3 manifest for the ingest preview pull.
3) Ben/Logan: we'll schedule 30 minutes of monitoring during the 09:00–12:00 PST window on 11/24. I'll own the orchestration and the reconciliation report.

If anyone prefers a quick 20-min runbook walkthrough instead of email, ping me and I'll set up a slot this afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Trust Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: ingest_preview_script.py (contains sample error-codes.csv generation), redwood_canonical_map_v1.csv (header example).
